data.raw_text: Members of Tindig Pilipinas, joined by Mamamayang Liberal Party-list Rep. Leila De Lima, hold a press conference on Wednesday, June 4, raising clenched fists with pink ribbons as a symbol of protest and solidarity, while calling for the immediate start of Vice President Duterte’s impeachment trial, asserting that complainants have sufficient evidence against her. (Photos by Santi San Juan/MB)
